title: A Little Further
logline: Four generations in Harar, from immigrant tailors to an AI engineer, each giving up something so the next could go a little further.
intent: At the end, viewers feel that one person's achievement is the accumulated sacrifice of many generations, and that the story is not finished: it is the narrator's turn to carry the family a little further.
end_card: Made with AI: characters and scenes are AI-generated, not real photographs.
Narration: Addis AI · Images: FLUX.2 klein · Motion: Wan 2.2 · Music: ACE-Step 1.5
For my mother, and everyone before her.
music_why: Director's pick, provisional until listening test (E10): only candidate whose loudness builds toward the end (+4.8 dB last quarter vs first two thirds), matching the caption's 'builds to a hopeful final section'; tied-lowest energy in the 1-4 kHz speech band (-12.5 dB vs full band), so it competes least with the narration. End-aligned so the build lands on s10-s11.
